SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Spring-animated expandable panel expanding height from 0 to auto without layout jank.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)
•
FAQ questions
•
Collapsible settings groups
•
Deep configuration sections
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
Standard persistent visible sidebars
•
Plain button clicks
JOBS TO BE DONE
Expand and collapse child content with smooth springy height interpolation
EXPECTED CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
CSS transition and animation transforms, reduced-motion fallbacks
